customer_name: Postal Savings Bank of China (中国邮政储蓄银行)
business_problem: PSBC needed a bank-wide AI platform that could coordinate model development and deployment across huge retail, credit, operations, and complaint-analysis workloads instead of leaving each financial use case to separate, slower model stacks.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud's AI middle-platform solution gave Postal Savings Bank of China a unified machine-learning and generative-AI foundation called 'Postal Brain.' The bank used the platform to standardize model planning and support intelligent applications across the whole enterprise, then iterated it through multiple phases toward a 'financial whole-brain' architecture that can serve many independent business scenarios. On top of the common platform, PSBC incubated AI-native applications such as test-case classification, trading robots, financial dialogue generation, finance-document assistance, and complaint analysis. The same stack supports smart-compute integration, broad data access, and model development at a scale large enough for 40,000 outlets, 650 million personal customers, and 1.8 billion accounts. By consolidating risk control, data intelligence, and model-development workflows inside one governed AI PaaS, the bank created an architecture that turns model delivery into an enterprise service instead of a one-off project.

solution_components.name: AI Mid-Platform Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the shared AI PaaS environment used to plan, train, iterate, and deploy models across PSBC's financial scenarios.

solution_components.name: Postal Brain
solution_components.role: Acts as the bank's unified machine-learning platform and incubator for AI-native business applications.

data_flow: Bank-wide data from retail credit, cards, trading, HR, legal, and complaint workflows feeds the unified AI mid-platform, Postal Brain trains and iterates models across those domains, and the resulting outputs are returned to risk-control, data-intelligence, and business-operations applications throughout the bank.
business_outcome: PSBC greatly sped up credit decisions and model iteration, created a reusable AI service layer for many financial departments, and gained an enterprise-scale platform for broader smart-banking transformation.
metrics: retail-loan approval cut from 5 minutes to under 10 seconds
model iteration shortened from 43 days to 10 hours
supports risk-pool modeling for about 1.4 billion accounts
supports image recognition for 4 million reimbursement transactions per year
architecture_clues: The platform evolved across multiple phases into a 'financial whole-brain' architecture rather than stopping at one machine-learning platform release.
It incubates AI-native apps alongside traditional machine-learning workloads on one shared stack.
The design is sized for tens of thousands of outlets and hundreds of millions of retail customers.
evidence_quotes: PSBC built the country's first bank-wide unified machine-learning platform among large commercial banks, called 'Postal Brain'. (original: 邮储银行构建了国内大型商业银行中首个落地的全行范围统一机器学习平台“邮储大脑”。)

The platform incubated AI-native applications such as test-case classification, trading robots, financial dialogue generation, financial document analysis, and complaint analysis. (original: 借助生成式大模型能力，孵化出测试用例分类、货币交易机器人、金融领域对话生成、金融领域辅助文档分析、金融领域投诉分析等AI原生应用。)
Retail credit approval was compressed from 5 minutes to under 10 seconds, and model iteration moved to a daily cadence. (original: 零售信贷自动化审批判断处理从5分钟压缩至10秒以内，实现了以天为周期的模型迭代。)

For credit-card and personal-loan businesses, the platform supports risk-pool modeling for about 1.4 billion accounts and shortened model iteration time from 43 days to 10 hours. (original: 支持信用卡、个贷等零售业务约14亿账户的风险分池建模，模型迭代时间从43天缩短到10小时。)
The data-intelligence layer is connected to six major data marts and more than 30 provincial branches. (original: 对接全行6大数据集市...30+省级分行接入营销获客和产品推荐应用。)
